devdoc.details: Grant this contract UMM_ROLE (Treasury) and DISTRIBUTOR_ROLE (YieldDistributor) to enable it.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

harvestAndDistribute(address,uint256).details: Compute `minPeggedTokenOut_` off-chain (e.g. eth_call-simulate this function); deriving it on-chain from `previewDeposit` is circular and never reverts. Keeper-gated for timing: each `distribute` re-spreads remaining yield over a fresh period, so an open call could stretch the drip.

params.minPeggedTokenOut_: Minimum pegged tokens the Gateway mint must produce
params.token_: Whitelisted collateral token to harvest the excess in

returns._distributed: Amount of pegged tokens sent to the YieldDistributor

harvestable().details: Reverts if any whitelisted token's oracle is stale or out of tolerance.

returns._excessPegged: Harvestable excess in pegged token units, or 0 if none.

params.receiver_: Address to receive the swept tokens

devdoc.title: YieldManager: One-shot yield operations for keepers

NAME().notice: Returns the name of the YieldManager

harvestAndDistribute(address,uint256).notice: KEEPER_ROLE: Harvest treasury excess payable in `token_`, mint pegged tokens by re-depositing it through the Gateway, and distribute the minted amount as staker yield.

harvestable().notice: The yield available to harvest, i.e. the excess of the treasury reserve over  the pegged token's backed supply: `reserve - (totalSupply - amoSupply)`.

sweep(address,address).notice: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE: Sweep tokens accidentally sent to this contract.

userdoc.notice: Chains `Treasury.harvest` -> `Gateway.deposit` (backed mint) -> `YieldDistributor.distribute` so a keeper turns treasury excess into staker yield in a single call.
